name: Fangan! OVA: Buried Secrets
summary:
Oscar De Boer is a very ordinary person with a very ordinary set of skills. Yet, he inespicably found himself trapped inside a farmhouse together with his 9 completely non-ordinary classmates. Killing them is the only way out.
Happily accepting the mantle of the protagonist, as that provides him with the ever-so-useful plot armor, it's up to him (and you too) to find a way to escape, and to solve a murder in the meanwhile.

What's this place really about?
